title: UTA Bus Routes
description: UTA Bus Routes in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 49 multilinestring features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: frequency
table:columns.description: Frequency (minutes). Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 49 rows, 5 distinct values.

table:columns.name: routetype
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 49 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: avgbrd
table:columns.description: AVG WKD Boarding. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 49 rows, 49 distinct values, ranging 12 to 4131.

table:columns.name: city
table:columns.description: City the feature falls in. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 49 rows, 37 distinct values.

table:columns.name: county
table:columns.description: County the feature falls in. Sandy is in Salt Lake County. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 49 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: Shape.STLength()
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
